Baoxun Electronics Co., Ltd. is located in Yangchun City, Guangdong Province, in a scenic area. For many years, our company has focused on the research, development, and processing of ultra-fine coaxial cable, and we also process wire harnesses such as electronic wire and FPC.

Our company is certified under ISO 9001 quality management system and ISO 14001 environmental management system. Through high-quality products, stable quality assurance, and very competitive price-performance, we have earned strong recognition from customers both in China and abroad.

We believe that diligence and professionalism can add greater value to your products. We value the approval of every customer and respect every criticism and suggestion. With even better quality and after-sales service, we sincerely look forward to working with you to build something great together.

pr: 동축 방식의 USB4 데이터 케이블. 3.2, 3.1, 3.0, 2와 호환되며, 속도 40Gbps, 출력 240W.
同轴版USB4数据线，可兼容3.2，3.1，3.0，2，速率40Gbps，功率240W。
IEPX(Aipei), HRS(Hirose), KEL(Kel), JAE(Japan Aviation Electronics) 등 미세 동축 커넥터 케이블의 가공 및 납땜.
爱沛（IEPX）、广濑（HRS）、科陆（KEL）、日本航空（JAE）、FPC等微同轴连接线都加工与焊接。
